title: Phenethylamines I Have Known And Loved — Complete Synthesis Library

compounds.name: Mescaline
compounds.description: The archetypal naturally occurring phenethylamine alkaloid, found in Lophophora williamsii (Peyote) and Echinopsis pachanoi (San Pedro).

routes.name: Condensation of 3,4,5-trimethoxybenzaldehyde with nitromethane followed by LAH reduction

workup.quench: Pour into crushed ice water with vigorous stirring
workup.isolation: Suction filtration of yellow crystalline nitrostyrene

workup.quench: Fieser workup: 4.5 mL H2O, 4.5 mL 15% NaOH, 13.5 mL H2O dropwise at 0 C
workup.isolation: Filter granular white aluminate salts, evaporate THF under vacuum
workup.salt_formation: Dissolve freebase in isopropanol, neutralize with concentrated HCl to pH 5.5

compounds.name: 2C-B
compounds.description: Core 2C-series compound synthesized via electrophilic aromatic bromination of 2C-H.

routes.name: Regioselective para-bromination of 2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine (2C-H)

steps.name: Electrophilic Bromination in Glacial Acetic Acid

conditions.addition_rate: Dropwise over 20 min with vigorous stirring

workup.quench: Precipitates directly as hydrobromide salt; wash with chilled acetic acid and ether
workup.conversion_to_hcl: Basify with 25% NaOH, extract freebase with DCM, gas with dry HCl

compounds.name: 2C-E
compounds.description: Potent 4-ethyl substituted 2C analogue synthesized from 1,4-dimethoxybenzene via Friedel-Crafts acylation, Clemmensen reduction, formylation, Henry reaction, and LAH reduction.

routes.name: Henry condensation of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-ethylbenzaldehyde and reduction

workup.quench: Ice water precipitation, suction filter orange crystals
Fieser quench at 0 C
workup.salt_formation: Dry HCl gas into anhydrous ether solution

compounds.name: 2C-I
compounds.description: 4-Iodo substituted 2C analogue synthesized by iodination of 2C-H with iodine monochloride (ICl).

routes.name: Iodination of 2C-H with Iodine Monochloride

workup.quench: Quench excess ICl with aqueous sodium bisulfite (NaHSO3) until yellow
workup.basification: Basify with 30% NaOH to pH 12, extract freebase with DCM

compounds.name: DOM (STP)
compounds.description: Prototypical 4-methyl substituted DOx amphetamine derivative, historically designated STP.

routes.name: Condensation of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylbenzaldehyde with nitroethane followed by LAH reduction

workup.quench: Ice water pour, collect heavy orange crystals of nitrostyrene
Fieser workup

compounds.name: DOB
compounds.description: High-potency 4-bromo DOx derivative synthesized via bromination of 2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine.

routes.name: Bromination of 2,5-DMA hydrochloride with bromine in glacial acetic acid

workup.quench: Product precipitates as HBr salt; convert to freebase with NaOH and form HCl salt

compounds.name: MDMA
compounds.description: Iconic entactogen synthesized from MDP2P via reductive amination with methylamine.

routes.name: Reductive amination of MDP2P with methylamine and NaBH4 or Al/Hg

workup.quench: Acidify to pH 1 with HCl, evaporate methanol, wash aqueous phase with ether
workup.basification: Basify aqueous phase with 30% NaOH to pH 12, extract freebase with DCM
workup.salt_formation: Dry over MgSO4, gas with anhydrous HCl

compounds.name: MDA
compounds.description: Primary amine entactogen precursor to MDMA, prepared via piperonal Henry reaction and LAH reduction.

routes.name: Henry condensation of piperonal with nitroethane followed by reduction

workup.quench: Ice water pour, collect bright yellow crystalline nitropropene
Fieser quench

compounds.name: TMA
compounds.description: Alpha-methyl homologue of mescaline. Synthesized via Henry condensation with nitroethane followed by hydride reduction.

routes.name: 3,4,5-Trimethoxybenzaldehyde + nitroethane -> LAH reduction

workup.quench: Pour into ice water, filter yellow-orange crystals
Fieser workup

compounds.name: 2C-T-7
compounds.description: Potent thioalkylated 2C compound with distinctive 5-HT2A binding kinetics.

routes.name: 2,5-Dimethoxy-4-(propylthio)benzaldehyde Henry condensation and reduction

workup.quench: Ice water crash precipitation, vacuum filter orange crystals
Fieser workup, filter salts, strip THF

compounds.name: 2C-T-2
compounds.description: Ethylthio analogue of 2C-T series with rapid onset and defined sensory enhancement.

routes.name: 2,5-Dimethoxy-4-(ethylthio)benzaldehyde route

workup.quench: Ice water precipitation
Fieser workup

compounds.name: MMDA
compounds.description: Essential oil constituent homologue derived from nutmeg myristicin via isomerization or myristicinaldehyde.

routes.name: Myristicinaldehyde condensation and reduction

workup.quench: Crash in ice water
Fieser workup

compounds.name: ALEPH
compounds.description: First of the sulfur-substituted amphetamines synthesized by Shulgin, exceptionally active at microgram doses.

routes.name: 2,5-Dimethoxy-4-(methylthio)benzaldehyde Henry condensation and reduction

workup.quench: Ice water pour, collect crimson-yellow crystals
Fieser workup

compounds.name: GANESHA
compounds.description: Polymethylated dimethoxyamphetamine named after the Hindu deity remover of obstacles.

routes.name: 2,5-Dimethoxy-3,4-dimethylbenzaldehyde route

workup.quench: Ice water precipitation
Fieser workup

compounds.name: 2C-C
compounds.description: 4-Chlorinated analogue of 2C-B. Synthesized by direct chlorination of 2C-H hydrochloride with sulfuryl chloride or elemental chlorine.

routes.name: Direct electrophilic chlorination of 2C-H with sulfuryl chloride

workup.quench: Dilute with 200 mL anhydrous diethyl ether; 2C-C HCl precipitates as snow-white crystals
workup.isolation: Filter on Büchner funnel, wash with cold ether, recrystallize from boiling isopropanol (mp 223-224 °C)

compounds.name: 2C-D
compounds.description: 4-Methylated member of the 2C-x family. Described by Shulgin as pharmacological 'tofu' that subtly modulates mental states.

routes.name: Condensation of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylbenzaldehyde with nitromethane and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Pour into ice water, filter heavy yellow needles, recrystallize from ethanol (mp 118 °C)
Glauber salt quench (H2O, 15% NaOH, H2O), filter, gas ether solution with HCl gas (mp 213-214 °C)

compounds.name: 2C-N
compounds.description: 4-Nitro derivative of 2C-H exhibiting an intense canary-yellow crystalline appearance and rapid onset.

routes.name: Direct aromatic nitration of 2C-H with nitric acid in acetic acid

workup.quench: Dilute with cold ether; filter bright yellow hydrochloride needles (mp 257-258 °C)

compounds.name: DOI
compounds.description: Ultra-potent 5-HT2A agonist widely used as an authoritative radioligand probe in neurological receptor binding assays.

routes.name: Electrophilic iodination of 2,5-DMA with iodine monochloride

workup.quench: Add ether to precipitate crude product; basify with NaOH, extract with DCM, gas with HCl to give white prisms (mp 200-201 °C)

compounds.name: DOC
compounds.description: High-potency long-duration substituted amphetamine derivative with selective 5-HT2 receptor affinity.

routes.name: Regioselective chlorination of 2,5-DMA with sulfuryl chloride

workup.quench: Precipitate with ether, recrystallize from boiling isopropanol to yield colorless needles (mp 192-193 °C)

compounds.name: MDEA (Eve)
compounds.description: N-Ethyl homologue of MDMA, known colloquially as 'Eve'. Synthesized by reductive amination of MDP2P with ethylamine.

routes.name: Reductive amination of MDP2P with ethylamine and NaBH3CN

workup.quench: Quench with HCl, evaporate methanol, basify with NaOH, extract with DCM, gas with HCl to give crystals (mp 201-202 °C)

compounds.name: Escaline
compounds.description: 4-Ethoxy homologue of mescaline. Significant potency increase over mescaline.

routes.name: Ethylation of syringaldehyde, Henry condensation, LAH reduction

workup.quench: Pour into water, filter 3,5-dimethoxy-4-ethoxybenzaldehyde (mp 53 °C)
Standard LAH workup, hydrochloride precipitation from ether (mp 165-166 °C)

compounds.name: Proscaline
compounds.description: 4-Propoxy homologue of mescaline with five-fold increased potency.

routes.name: O-Propylation of syringaldehyde followed by nitrostyrene reduction

workup.quench: Dilute with water, isolate 4-propoxybenzaldehyde, condense with nitromethane and reduce with LAH (mp 152-153 °C)

compounds.name: Allylescaline (AL)
compounds.description: 4-Allyloxy derivative of mescaline with unique visual character.

routes.name: O-Allylation of syringaldehyde, Henry condensation, LAH reduction

workup.quench: Isolate allyloxybenzaldehyde, form nitrostyrene, reduce with LAH, precipitate hydrochloride (mp 170-171 °C)

compounds.name: 2C-P
compounds.description: Potent 4-propyl substituted phenethylamine with long duration and rich visual geometry.

routes.name: Henry condensation of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-propylbenzaldehyde with nitromethane and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Filter crystalline orange nitrostyrene, reduce with LAH in refluxing THF, precipitate hydrochloride salt (mp 204-205 °C)

compounds.name: 2C-T
compounds.description: Parent member of the 2C-T sulfur-containing phenethylamine family.

routes.name: Condensation of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-(methylthio)benzaldehyde with nitromethane and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Recrystallize nitrostyrene from isopropanol, reduce with LAH in dry THF, bubble anhydrous HCl into ether solution to precipitate 2C-T hydrochloride (mp 238-239 °C)

compounds.name: 2C-T-21
compounds.description: Fluorinated thioethyl phenethylamine showing profound sensory enhancement.

routes.name: Alkylation of 4-mercapto-2,5-dimethoxybenzaldehyde with 1-bromo-2-fluoroethane and reduction

workup.quench: Isolate fluoroethylthio benzaldehyde, condense with nitromethane, reduce with LAH, precipitate hydrochloride (mp 194-195 °C)

compounds.name: TMA-2
compounds.description: Positional isomer of TMA derived from asarone; active at low milligram dosage.

routes.name: Condensation of 2,4,5-trimethoxybenzaldehyde with nitroethane followed by LAH reduction

workup.quench: Filter canary-yellow nitropropene crystals, reduce in dry THF with LAH, precipitate hydrochloride salt (mp 188-189 °C)

compounds.name: TMA-6
compounds.description: Symmetrical 2,4,6-trimethoxy substitution pattern yielding high potency.

routes.name: Condensation of 2,4,6-trimethoxybenzaldehyde with nitroethane and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Filter crystalline nitropropene, reduce with LAH, precipitate hydrochloride (mp 210-211 °C)

compounds.name: MEM
compounds.description: 4-Ethoxy analog of 2C-D and mescaline congeners with gentle empathogenic profile.

routes.name: O-Ethylation of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-hydroxybenzaldehyde, Henry reaction, LAH reduction

workup.quench: Isolate 4-ethoxy aldehyde, form nitrostyrene with nitromethane, reduce with LAH, precipitate hydrochloride salt (mp 208-209 °C)

compounds.name: Buscaline
compounds.description: 4-Butoxy homolog of mescaline synthesized by Ann & Alexander Shulgin.

routes.name: O-Butylation of syringaldehyde, Henry condensation, LAH reduction

workup.quench: Isolate butoxybenzaldehyde, condense with nitromethane, reduce with LAH, precipitate hydrochloride (mp 162-163 °C)

compounds.name: Aleph-2
compounds.description: 4-Ethylthio amphetamine congener with intense entheogenic acuity.

routes.name: Condensation of 4-ethylthio-2,5-dimethoxybenzaldehyde with nitroethane and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Filter yellow nitropropene, reduce with LAH in THF, precipitate hydrochloride salt (mp 196-197 °C)

compounds.name: Aleph-4
compounds.description: 4-Isopropylthio derivative showing marked sensory and visual depth.

routes.name: Nitroethane condensation with 4-isopropylthio-2,5-dimethoxybenzaldehyde and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Recrystallize nitropropene from isopropanol, reduce with LAH in dry ether, precipitate hydrochloride (mp 182-183 °C)

compounds.name: Aleph-7
compounds.description: 4-Propylthio homolog of the Aleph series with balanced somatic and visual character.

routes.name: Condensation of 4-propylthio-2,5-dimethoxybenzaldehyde with nitroethane and LAH reduction

workup.quench: Isolate crystalline nitropropene, reduce with LAH, convert to hydrochloride salt (mp 178-179 °C)

compounds.name: MBDB
compounds.description: Eden / Methyl-J: Alpha-ethyl homolog of MDMA displaying pure empathogenic entactogen properties without psychomotor stimulation.

routes.name: Reductive amination of 1-(1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)butan-2-one with methylamine

workup.quench: Basify, extract into ether, wash with brine, bubble anhydrous HCl to precipitate MBDB hydrochloride (mp 156 °C)

compounds.name: PEA
compounds.description: Endogenous trace amine neurotransmitter and structural parent of all phenethylamines.

routes.name: Catalytic hydrogenation or LAH reduction of benzyl cyanide (phenylacetonitrile)

workup.quench: Fieser workup (4.2 mL H2O, 4.2 mL 15% NaOH, 12.6 mL H2O), filter granular aluminum oxide salts, distill freebase (bp 197 °C), precipitate hydrochloride (mp 217 °C)
